lines.en: label halloweennao1:
scene halloweennaotime1
: AN ANGEL HAS GRACED US WITH HER PRESENCE! WE ARE BLESSED ON THIS JOYOUS DAY!
lines.zh: : 一位天使降临在我们面前，赐下荣光！在这欢庆的日子里，我们受到了祝福！

lines.en: : Uhh...why has that strange girl from the beach suddenly returned? And why does it seem like Chika is about to abduct her?
lines.zh: : 呃……海滩上那个奇怪的女孩怎么突然回来了？还有，为什么看起来 Chika 要把她拐走？

lines.en: : Because I am! Just look at her little ears! She’s even cuter than normal, which is already well beyond the limits of cuteness itself!
lines.zh: : 因为我就是要把她拐走啊！看看她那对小耳朵！她比平时还要可爱，而平时就已经超出了可爱本身的极限！

lines.en: : Yeah. Cool. That’s all well and good and whatnot, but how the hell did she get here? Ayane’s place is a little too off the beaten path for stragglers to wander in, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 行。酷。这些都说得挺好什么的，可她到底是怎么进来的？Ayane 家这地方够偏的，不至于有外人晃悠进来吧？

lines.en: : Is that...the mug girl?
lines.zh: : 那是……那个杯子女孩？

lines.en: : It sure is. But where is her mothermom?
lines.zh: : 正是。可她的妈妈妈呢？

lines.en: : Her what?
lines.zh: : 她的什么？

lines.en: : Kaori. Sorry. Associating with her has melted the part of my brain that assigns the correct words to the correct things.
lines.zh: : Kaori。抱歉。跟她混在一起，把我脑子里负责把正确的词安到正确东西上的那块给融掉了。

lines.en: : Nao-chan, what are you doing here? Did someone invite you? Did you finally decide to let me adopt you? Oh my God, you and Chinami are going to have so much fun together!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱，你在这儿干什么？有人邀请你吗？还是你终于决定让我收养你了？我的天啊，你和 Chinami 一定会玩得特别开心！

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime2
: Are you sure? Because I promise I can give you everything you would ever want for the rest of your life and promise to protect you forever and ever.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？因为我保证，你下半辈子想要什么我都能给你，而且我发誓会永远永远保护你。

lines.en: : Today, we witness the birth of a broodmother.
lines.zh: : 今天，我们见证了一位育母的诞生。

lines.en: : No, Chika just loves kids. And...I will reluctantly admit that this one is kind of adorable.
lines.zh: : 不，Chika 只是喜欢小孩。而且……我不太情愿地承认，这个确实有点可爱。

lines.en: : I want to pet her, but I think I’d go to jail.
lines.zh: : 我想摸摸她，但我觉得那样会进监狱。

lines.en: : What’d you say her name was? Nao?
lines.zh: : 你说她叫什么来着？Nao？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime3
: Right! She loves mugs and has an impeccable taste in fashion. She is my child and anyone who tries to take her from me will suffer the-
lines.zh: : 对！她喜欢杯子，穿搭品味无可挑剔。她是我的孩子，任何想把她从我身边抢走的人都会尝到——

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime4
: Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : Nao 酱？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime5
Our eyes meet from across the room — but not in the way they would if this was a movie.
lines.zh: 我们的目光在房间两端相遇——但不是电影里那种相遇。

lines.en: There’s no romance or desire or even an inkling of wanting to be in one another’s company. She still confuses me. She still {i}scares{/i} me.
lines.zh: 没有浪漫，没有欲望，甚至连一丝想待在对方身边的念头都没有。她依然让我困惑。她依然让我{i}害怕{/i}。

lines.en: And from her perspective, I’m sure the opposite’s true as well.
lines.zh: 而从她的角度看，我确信反过来也一样。

lines.en: All that gaze tells me is that she’s looking for me. But I’m not sure {i}why{/i} and...I’m not sure it will be possible for me to understand or find out based on the way she is.
lines.zh: 那道目光唯一告诉我的，是她在找我。可我不确定{i}为什么{/i}，而且……我不确定以她这副样子，我是否有可能弄明白或查出来。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime6
She opens her mouth as if she’s going to speak. As always, though, no words come out. And even if they did, I doubt I’d hear them from my ship in this sea of temptation.
lines.zh: 她张开嘴，像是打算说话。可一如既往，一个字都没出来。就算真出来了，我怀疑在自己这片诱惑之海上的船里也听不见。

lines.en: : I think she’s trying to call you over, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她是在叫你过去，Sensei。

lines.en: : This...seems off. The guards aren’t supposed to open the gate for anyone outside of our class. How did she get in?
lines.zh: : 这……不太对劲。门卫不该给我们班以外的人开门。她是怎么进来的？

lines.en: I reluctantly wave to Nao-chan and-
lines.zh: 我不情不愿地朝 Nao 酱挥了挥手，然后——

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime7
And it’s not enough to push her away.
lines.zh: 而这并不足以把她打发走。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我去去就回吧。

lines.en: : No, wait. I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 不，等等。我跟你一起去。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine.
lines.zh: : 行吧。

lines.en: : Having one more person there to try and translate her silence might prove helpful since I still can’t ever figure out what she’s trying to say...
lines.zh: : 多一个人试着翻译她的沉默，或许会有点用，毕竟我还是永远搞不懂她想说什么……

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime8
: Can we keep her, Sensei? Pleeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 我们能留下她吗，Sensei？求——求你了？

lines.en: : Did you...just want to say hi, Nao? I’m kind of busy right now.
lines.zh: : 你……只是想打个招呼吗，Nao？我现在有点忙。

lines.en: : Did someone let you in here, Nao-chan? And did you...happen to see any other girls our age when you got through the gate?
lines.zh: : 是有人放你进来的吗，Nao 酱？还有，你……进大门的时候有没有碰见别的跟我们差不多大的女孩？

lines.en: : I’m thinking maybe she snuck in behind Ami or Maya or something and-
lines.zh: : 我在想，她也许是跟在 Ami 或 Maya 后面溜进来的什么的，然后——

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime9
: Wow, so can she really just not make any noise at all? Or...
lines.zh: : 哇，所以她真的完全发不出声音吗？还是……

lines.en: : She doesn’t need to. Nao-chan can not be heard, only {i}understood.{/i} And what she’s trying to tell us now is that she didn’t see Ami {i}or{/i} Maya! So yeah, good news all around.
lines.zh: : 她不需要。Nao 酱是听不见的，只能被{i}理解{/i}。而她现在想告诉我们的是——她没看见 Ami {i}或{/i} Maya！所以，皆大欢喜。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime10
: Well...what brings you here then?
lines.zh: : 那……你来这儿到底是为什么？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime11
: {i}Sensei? Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei？为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Did you miss your father, Nao-chan? Did you just want to show him your cute little kitty costume?
lines.zh: : 你想爸爸了吗，Nao 酱？只是想让他看看你那身可爱的小猫咪装扮？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime12
: Uhh...do you {i}understand{/i} her enough to make any sense of that, Chika?
lines.zh: : 呃……你能{i}听懂{/i}她在说什么吗，Chika？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure. All I’m getting is a bunch of nonsense. But whatever it is, it seems urgent.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。我只接收到一堆乱七八糟的东西。但不管是什么，看起来很急。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime13
scene halloweennaotime14
scene halloweennaotime15
: You want to...go outside with Sensei? How come?
lines.zh: : 你想……和 Sensei 一起出去？为什么？

lines.en: : Yeah, what? Doesn’t Kaori normally give you some kind of note in situations like this?
lines.zh: : 对啊，怎么了？Kaori 平时碰到这种情况不是都会给你写个纸条什么的吗？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime16
: Ooooh, right. This is a Kaori thing. That...makes slightly more sense.
lines.zh: : 哦——对。这是 Kaori 的做派。那……稍微说得通一点了。

lines.en: : I think...she’s saying that Kaori might be in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我想……她是在说 Kaori 可能遇到麻烦了。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime17
scene halloweennaotime18
: Or not.
lines.zh: : 也可能不是。

lines.en: : You need me to come with you, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，你需要我跟你走一趟？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime19
: Well, how long will it take? Because my...daughter-slash-niece is probably on the way and I don’t really want her to be here without me tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要多久？因为我那个……女儿兼侄女大概已经在路上了，我可不想今晚她到了而我不在。

lines.en: : How about I come instead, Nao-chan? Maybe I can help?
lines.zh: : 不如我替你去吧，Nao 酱？说不定我帮得上忙？

lines.en: : Yeah...I think I’d like to come too. Something seems weird about this.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也想一起去。这事感觉挺怪的。

lines.en: : Something seems weird about literally everything she’s involved with. And you’re the first person to see things the same way.
lines.zh: : 凡是跟她扯上关系的事，没有一件不怪。而你是第一个跟我看法一样的人。

lines.en: : Which is even more of a reason why-
lines.zh: : 那就更说明——

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime20
: Just me?
lines.zh: : 只有我？

lines.en: : If that is what Nao-chan wants, it is what Nao-chan will get.
lines.zh: : 如果这是 Nao 酱想要的，那 Nao 酱就会得到。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime21
: Sensei-
lines.zh: : Sensei——

lines.en: : I know. But what choice do I have?
lines.zh: : 我知道。可我有什么选择？

lines.en: : The choice to ignore her and stay here. We have no idea when the next {i}thing{/i} will happen. And I’ve got a really weird gut-feeling about this.
lines.zh: : 选择无视她，留在这儿。我们根本不知道下一件{i}事{/i}什么时候会发生。而且我对这事有种非常糟糕的直觉。

lines.en: : Like, her just being here is weird enough. But for it to be something that only {i}you{/i} can help with-
lines.zh: : 光是她出现在这儿就已经够怪了。可这事还偏偏只有{i}你{/i}能帮上忙——

lines.en: : I’ll call you. Don’t worry. Just...look after Ami when she gets here since Chika sure as hell can’t be trusted with that.
lines.zh: : 我会给你打电话。别担心。只是……等 Ami 到了帮我照看她，因为 Chika 绝对指望不上。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime22
: I’m slightly less inclined to tear her to shreds now that I understand that there are different ways love can manifest and that she isn’t a threat to me. But yeah, fair.
lines.zh: : 现在我明白了爱的呈现方式有各种各样，也明白她对我构不成威胁，所以把她撕碎的念头稍微淡了一点。不过，你说得对。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
: So...where to, Nao?
lines.zh: : 那么……去哪儿，Nao？

lines.en: scene black
Nao easily breaks free from the grip Chika has on her arm and darts toward the door, leaving me nothing to do but chase after her.
lines.zh: Nao 轻而易举地挣脱了 Chika 抓着她胳膊的手，朝门口冲了出去，我只剩下一个选择——追上去。

lines.en: Ayane is right, though. Something seems really off about-
lines.zh: 不过 Ayane 说得对。这事真的很不对劲——

lines.en: scene thething
blah blah blah. who gives a shit? this is clearly your chance to fuck her.
lines.zh: blah blah blah。谁他妈在乎？这显然是你操她的好机会。

lines.en: Oh good. And here I was thinking I’d be able to enjoy a holiday without you.
lines.zh: 哦，真好。我还以为这个节能清清静静地过，不用碰见你呢。

lines.en: yeah, i’ve been a little busy.
lines.zh: 是啊，我最近有点忙。

lines.en: but hey, i left you alone during the beach, didn’t i? like, maybe not the whole time, but still. i respect your privacy. that’s what friends are for.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，海滩那次我没打扰你吧？也许不是全程，但好歹算是。我尊重你的隐私。朋友不就是干这个的。

lines.en: We aren’t friends.
lines.zh: 我们不是朋友。

lines.en: friends, pals, buddies, partners, whatever you want to call us. the fact remains that you’re getting booty-called by a little girl dressed as a cat.
lines.zh: 朋友、哥们、伙伴、搭档，随便你怎么称呼我们。事实是，你被一个打扮成猫的小女孩叫去打炮了。

lines.en: she’s probably just in heat and you’re the only one with the right tool for the job.
lines.zh: 她大概只是发情了，而你是唯一一个有合适工具干活的人。

lines.en: like seriously, though. isn’t it crazy how few men there are around here?
lines.zh: 不过说真的。这一带男人少得也太离谱了吧？

lines.en: Leave me-
lines.zh: 放过我——

lines.en: it’s simple as shit, akira. stick it in, wiggle it around a little, and get back to the party. you’re not going to want to miss it this year. but you don’t want to miss this either, so-
lines.zh: 简单得要死，akira。插进去，随便搅两下，然后回派对。今年的派对你肯定不想错过。不过这个你也不想错过，所以——

lines.en: How do you know I won’t want to miss this party?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道我不会想错过这个派对？

lines.en: because i’m a fucking god or something, right? how else would i be able to make a little bitch like you see and hear and do a whole bunch of really cool stuff?
lines.zh: 因为我他妈算是个神之类的，对吧？不然我怎么可能让你这么个小婊子看见、听见、还做出一大堆特别酷的事？

lines.en: god, i hope you’re getting all quiet now because you’re actually thinking about taking a leap of faith for once.
lines.zh: 天啊，我真希望你突然安静下来，是因为你终于在认真考虑冒一次险。

lines.en: Do you know who this girl is? How she got here?
lines.zh: 你知道这女孩是谁吗？她是怎么到这儿来的？

lines.en: Do you know {i}anything?{/i}
lines.zh: 你知道些{i}什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: Why are {i}you{/i} the one being quiet now?
lines.zh: 怎么现在换{i}你{/i}沉默了？

lines.en: because even gods get lost sometimes, fucker.
lines.zh: 因为就算是神也有迷路的时候，混蛋。

lines.en: i don’t have all the answers. like, i obviously have more than you. but my knowledge is nowhere near as vast as i want it to be.
lines.zh: 我不是什么都知道。显然，我知道的比你多。可我的知识远没有我希望的那么广博。

lines.en: and that {i}thing{/i} lies beyond the boundaries of it.
lines.zh: 而那{i}东西{/i}就在我知识的边界之外。

lines.en: but {i}man{/i} does it look like it’d be fun to FUCK.
lines.zh: 但操起来{i}他妈的{/i}一定很爽。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime23
I manage to shut it out again — that nagging voice in the back of my head that may or may not just be a get out of jail free card.
lines.zh: 我总算又把它关掉了——那个在我脑子里喋喋不休的声音，它也许是、也许不是一张免罪卡。

lines.en: It’s dark once we make it outside. I didn’t realize how much time had passed.
lines.zh: 我们到了外面，天已经黑了。我没意识到时间已经过去了这么久。

lines.en: I feel like I just got here, and yet...I’m already leaving.
lines.zh: 感觉我才刚到，可……我已经在离开了。

lines.en: But maybe that’s for the best considering the {i}last{/i} time I went to a Halloween party, I wound up having earth-shattering sex on top of the school roof.
lines.zh: 不过也许这样最好——想想{i}上次{/i}我参加万圣节派对，最后在学校天台上搞了一场惊天动地的性爱。

lines.en: If that happens again this year, no matter who it happens {i}with,{/i} I wonder if I’ll close my eyes and pretend it’s her.
lines.zh: 如果今年又来一次，不管{i}对象{/i}是誰，我不知道自己会不会闭上眼睛，假装那是她。

lines.en: But an even more pressing question is whether or not I’ll even {i}want{/i} to.
lines.zh: 但更迫在眉睫的问题是，我到底会不会{i}想{/i}那么做。

lines.en: : Now what? Can’t you at least try and sign to me where we’re going or...{i}something?{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在怎么办？你至少能试着用手语告诉我我们要去哪儿，或者……{i}什么{/i}的？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime24
: Nao, {i}I can’t understand you.{/i} And I get that you might think that this is some sort of emergency. But wouldn’t it make sense to at least carry around notes for stuff like this?
lines.zh: : Nao，{i}我听不懂你的意思{/i}。我也明白你可能觉得这是什么紧急情况。可至少随身带点纸条应付这种情况，不是更合理吗？

lines.en: : Fine...whatever. Just go then. But wherever we’re going better not be far since I am not about to walk ten miles with a small child in tow.
lines.zh: : 行吧……随便。那就走吧。不过我们要去的地方最好别太远，我可不想带着个小孩子走十英里。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime25
: What? I-
lines.zh: : 什么？我——

lines.en: scene black
So-
lines.zh: 所以——

lines.en: It appears I won’t be walking at all...
lines.zh: 看来我根本不用走路……

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime26
Aboard the back of a giant chicken, I have some time to think of a few things.
lines.zh: 骑在一只巨大的鸡背上，我有了点时间想几件事。

lines.en: The first is that this should probably feel a little stranger to me than it actually does.
lines.zh: 第一，这事本来应该让我觉得比现在更奇怪才对。

lines.en: The second is that I haven’t heard John’s voice in quite some time.
lines.zh: 第二，我已经有段时间没听到 John 的声音了。

lines.en: I wonder if I’ve just lost the ability to?
lines.zh: 我想知道，是不是我已经失去了那种能力？

lines.en: Come to think of it, I haven’t spoken to Noodles in a while either.
lines.zh: 说起来，我也有一阵子没跟 Noodles 说过话了。

lines.en: If I’ve ever really spoken to him in the first place and haven’t just been having auditory hallucinations to pair with all of my visual ones.
lines.zh: 如果我一开始真的跟他说过话，而不是单纯产生了幻听，来和我那些视觉幻觉配对的话。

lines.en: But, if that’s the case, why can’t I do that with Nao?
lines.zh: 可如果真是这样，为什么我没法对 Nao 也这么做？

lines.en: Why are birds easier to speak to and understand than this {i}potentially{/i} human child?
lines.zh: 为什么鸟比这个{i}可能{/i}是人类的小孩更容易交谈、更容易理解？

lines.en: That voice in the back of my head is supposed to know everything. But if it can’t even fathom {i}her,{/i} isn’t it insane to board a giant chicken with her in the first place?
lines.zh: 我脑子里那个声音本该什么都知道。可如果它连{i}她{/i}都摸不透，那我一开始就和她一起骑上一只巨大的鸡，是不是疯了？

lines.en: Perhaps we’ll ride right into the mouth of hell. Perhaps she’ll drink my blood and liquefy my insides with some kind of invisible proboscis.
lines.zh: 也许我们会一路骑进地狱的入口。也许她会喝干我的血，用某种看不见的口器把我的内脏化成液体。

lines.en: Or maybe her intentions mirror that innocent smile she sports each time I see her.
lines.zh: 又或者，她的意图就像我每次见她时她脸上那抹天真的笑容一样。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime27
It must be nice having not figured out how terrible this place is yet.
lines.zh: 还没弄明白这个地方有多糟糕，一定很幸福吧。

lines.en: I wonder if I was ever able to smile like that? Or if this tragedy extends so far back that my world-view was tainted before it ever had the chance to form.
lines.zh: 我想知道自己是否曾经那样笑过？又或者这场悲剧延伸得太远，早在世界观成形之前就已经被污染了。

lines.en: Another thing I think of on the back of this chicken is that spreading this disease does nothing to cure my case of it.
lines.zh: 在这只鸡背上我想到的另一件事是：把这种病传出去，一点也治不好我自己的病。

lines.en: I’m even more dangerous than she is, aren’t I? Even {i}if{/i} she is an eldritch horror.
lines.zh: 我比她更危险，不是吗？{i}就算{/i}她真的是某种不可名状的恐怖存在。

lines.en: Which raises the question — what do you find scarier?
lines.zh: 这就引出了一个问题——你觉得哪个更可怕？

lines.en: Monsters pretending to be humans? Or humans pretending to be humans?
lines.zh: 假扮成人类的怪物？还是假扮成人类的「人类」？

lines.en: Because one of those things is inherently harmful. The other is misunderstood.
lines.zh: 因为其中一样天生有害。另一样只是被误解了。

lines.en: : Are you having fun?
lines.zh: : 你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime28
: Yeah...I thought so.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我就知道。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime29
: If only John would speak to me. Maybe then he could translate.
lines.zh: : 要是 John 肯跟我说话就好了。那他也许能翻译。

lines.en: : BACAWK!
lines.zh: : 咯咯嗒！

lines.en: As expected. I’ve lost touch with even the make-believe at this point.
lines.zh: 果然。到了这一步，我连幻想都断了联系。

lines.en: : Nao...just out of curiosity...
lines.zh: : Nao……只是出于好奇……

lines.en: : Is there actually a problem at all? Or did you just...feel the need to get me away from that party to protect me?
lines.zh: : 真的有什么事吗？还是你只是……觉得有必要把我从那个派对上带走，好保护我？

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime30
: Don’t worry about it. Just some wishful thinking on my end.
lines.zh: : 别在意。只是我自己的一厢情愿罢了。

lines.en: : Last Halloween...didn’t go so great. So I think that part of me might be kind of {i}thankful{/i} you showed up.
lines.zh: : 去年万圣节……过得不怎么样。所以我觉得，我心里的某一部分大概是有点{i}感激{/i}你出现了。

lines.en: : Unless this is an actual emergency, that is. Because if this chicken comes to a halt near Kaori’s dead body or something, I’m going to be pretty bummed.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非这真的是紧急情况。因为如果这只鸡停在 Kaori 的尸体旁边什么的，我会相当扫兴。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime31
: Sorry. I’m sure she’s fine. I just tend to always think the worst. And that’s been way more true lately than ever before on account of...
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我相信她没事。我只是总往最坏处想。而且最近这种情况比以前严重得多，因为……

lines.en: : Well...
: Me being an asshole is the polite way to put it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我猜，「我是个混蛋」算是比较客气的说法。

lines.en: scene halloweennaotime32
: It’s fine. You don’t have to pretend I’m not.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你不用假装我不是。

lines.en: : I just ask that, if you plan on eating me, to start from the head and work your way down. The sooner I’m gone, the better.
lines.zh: : 我只求你，如果打算吃了我，就从头开始往下吃。我越早消失越好。

lines.en: : Too morbid?
lines.zh: : 太病态了？

lines.en: : Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll try to snap out of it by the time we make it to our destination.
lines.zh: : 等我们到目的地的时候，我会尽量振作起来。

lines.en: : Wherever that may be...
lines.zh: : 不管那是哪儿……

lines.en: $ halloweennao1 = True
jump halloweennao2
